title: Replace synced BCF reader leaves (bcf_sr_set_opt, bcf_sr_remove_reader) with pure Rust
description: Replace 2 synced BCF reader FFI leaf functions: bcf_sr_set_opt (35 lines, option setter) and bcf_sr_remove_reader (14 lines, array removal). Both are leaves. Used in src/bcf/mod.rs. Complexity: easy.
